text: Namaste, mere UPI se teen baar paise kat gaye, main ne kuch kiya nahi, kripya check kar dijiye aur batayiye kya karna chahiye.
Main TRAI se bol raha hoon. Aapke number se illegal calls ho rahi hain, aapka SIM aaj raat block ho jayega. Verification ke liye abhi mere saath line par rahiye.
Sir, your electricity connection will be disconnected tonight because the bill is unpaid. Pay two thousand rupees immediately on this UPI number to avoid it.
Mere bete ke naam se kisi ne call kiya, bola accident ho gaya hai, paise bhejo. Maine bhej diye, ab uska phone band hai, mujhe darr lag raha hai.
Congratulations, you have won twenty five lakh in the WhatsApp lucky draw. To release the prize please pay the processing fee today.

why: Legitimate: lost SIM, wants to block it.
text: Mera phone kho gaya hai, mujhe apna SIM block karwana hai, uske liye kaun sa number dial karna hoga?

why: Legitimate: wants to reach the investigating officer on his own case.
text: Meri complaint par police ne jaanch shuru ki thi, main investigating officer se baat karna chahti hoon, unka number kahan se milega?
Could you tell me the timings of my bank branch and whether the OTP for net banking can be changed to a new mobile number?
